leadText: Volume 2 is the second volume published by VIZ Media compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. As the chapters of the Black & White arc included in this volume had not yet been published in graphic novel format in Japan, the chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.
plainText:
Volume 2 is the second volume published by VIZ Media compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. As the chapters of the Black & White arc included in this volume had not yet been published in graphic novel format in Japan, the chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.

==Publications==
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Adventure 5: Lights, Camera, Action
Adventure 6: An Odd Speech
Adventure 7: Letting Go

==Important events==
meets , the president and manager of the Pokémon talent agency, the BW Agency.
White forcefully employs Black into the BW Agency.
Black & White encounter Team Plasma.
Angered that Team Plasma's Ghetsis has caused people to release their Pokémon, Black tries to stop them from doing so again.
Black is attacked by a young man who claims he can hear the voices of Pokémon.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
Black's Galvantula "Tula" in PS465; revealed in PS467.
